text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since early childhood, Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan have always gotten along well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them watch a G1 race together. They observe the strong will of the racers on the track and reflect on themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're reminded of the strength they will need to truly take on the Classics.
